title: T23 desktop: themes — live look switching on the Coworkers page
head: t23-themes
body:
## What

T23 desktop half (decisions #77, #78, #167, #178; contract §1, §2, §5, §6, §8). A theme pack's checked values from the service (`GET /themes/:id/tokens`, JSON) become the root's `--oasis-*` custom properties at runtime, live, in every window.

- `src/design/tokens.ts`: pinned name lists (21 colours per variant, 4 radii, 5 durations + breath, 3 easings; font fixed to Figtree). `packProperties` walks only those lists, so a pack can never add or reach a fixed name. The bundled `LANTERN` pack is written out and tested equal to today's values. `applyTokens(theme, pack)`: under reduced motion every duration and the breath are written as 0.
- `src/design/themePack.ts`: field-by-field parse of the service's values, the cached pick (`theme-pack` in localStorage), `setThemePack`. `startTheme()` applies the cached pack before first paint (main window, quick box, orb) and re-applies on pack change, another window's `storage` event, system appearance, or reduced motion. No reload.
- `src/design/sound.ts`: `sounds` only picks bundled cues. An unknown id plays `default`.
- `src/lib/themeClient.ts` (loaded on first use): `listThemes`, `refreshThemes`, `getTheme`, `setTheme`, `getThemeTokens`, `startThemeInstall`, `getThemeInstall` on the contract §4 route names. WS `theme.changed` comes in on the same socket as `avatar.changed`.
- Coworkers page: a new "Look" list in the same cards, each with a small swatch. An installed look is fetched, saved with one `PUT /theme`, and applied only when that returns 200. If the save fails, the old look stays and a calm line explains. A library look is fetched by an install job with `select: true`.
- Settings: a "Your look" row (swatch, name, "✓ In use") and "Change look ›" to the Coworkers page. Settings never lists looks.
- Get started: picking an avatar set also picks the look with the same id (PUT if installed, else an install job with `select: true`). A set with no matching look leaves the look alone.
- The app follows the service at start (`GET /theme`) and on WS `theme.changed`.
- Main CSS 77.59 / 11.78 kB (budget 78 / 12, #178). No new dependencies. Version stays 0.1.0.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

15/15 killed. Each mutant was applied by editing, run under vitest, then restored by re-applying the original text.

| # | Mutant | Killed by |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | switching requires reload (no live event) | theme.test: switching packs rewrites the root live; themePacks: a pick switches the whole app live |
| 1 | applyTokens accepts a pack-supplied name | tokens.test: a pack cannot add a name or reach a fixed one |
| 2 | reduced motion plays the pack's durations | theme.test: reduced motion zeroes every duration and the breath |
| 3 | Get started pick ignores theme | themePacks: picking a set whose look is installed / still in the library |
| 4 | Lantern differs from today | tokens.test: Lantern is exactly today's light values |
| 5 | dark variant ignored | tokens.test / theme.test: both variants |
| 6 | look applied before PUT answers | themePacks: a PUT that fails keeps the old look |
| 7 | repeat pick PUTs again | themePacks: one PUT (survived at first; the test now waits for the second click's work, then killed) |
| 8 | other windows do not follow storage | theme.test: another window's pick switches this window |
| 9 | WS theme.changed ignored | themePacks: follows the service on WS theme.changed |
| 10 | cached pack not applied at start (flash) | theme.test: applies the cached pack synchronously at start |
| 11 | unknown sound id not falling back | sound.test: an unknown id plays the default |
| 12 | Settings look row lists every look | Settings.test: never a list of looks (contract §5 review catch, also a test) |
| 13 | avatarWatch.ts drops the `theme.changed` branch (frame parsed, then discarded) | themePacks: "the one socket hands theme.changed to its own handler and avatar.changed to the orb relay"; "follows the service at start and on WS theme.changed from another window or device" |
| 14 | useAvatarRelay.ts stops passing `onThemeChange` to `watchAvatarChanges` (follow() never wired to the socket) | themePacks: "follows the service at start and on WS theme.changed from another window or device" |

## Tests

- `npm run typecheck`: clean
- `npm run lint`: 0 errors, 1 old warning (Onboarding.tsx, unchanged)
- `npm test`: 57 files, 1144 tests passed
- `vite build`: main CSS 77.59 kB / 11.78 kB gzip

New: `tests/themePacks.test.tsx`, `tests/themeFixtures.ts`. Extended: `tests/tokens.test.ts`, `tests/theme.test.ts`, `tests/sound.test.ts`, `tests/Settings.test.tsx`. The fake service and the in-memory avatar client gain the theme routes.

## Mac check

Needs agent-core with the T23 routes. Until the palettes job ships, only Lantern (and any drawer look) exists.
1. Open the app. It looks exactly as it does today (Lantern).
2. Settings shows "Your look: Lantern ✓ In use". Click "Change look ›". The Coworkers page opens, with "Look" under the coworkers.
3. With a second look installed (drawer), pick it. The main window, the quick box and the orb change at once, with no restart. Switch Light/Dark in Settings: both variants follow.
4. Quit and reopen. It opens in the picked look, with no flash of Lantern.
5. With Reduce motion on (System Settings › Accessibility › Display), nothing animates in any look.
